values.One-line pitch: A tiny arena collector: gather the stars, dodge the hazards, beat the clock.
values.Win condition: Collect 6 stars each round to clear the round; clear all 3 rounds to win
values.Lose / fail condition: Touch a hazard, or let the round timer run out
values.Difficulty target (who it is for, how ha: Casual — gentle for a first-time player
values.Must-have features (max 3): Rounds with rising hazards; a pause menu; a saved best score
values.Proportions / outline / shading rules: Soft rounded shapes, no outlines, flat pastel fills (follows the soft-pastel sample)
values.Audio mood (music + SFX character): Light marimba plucks; soft collect chimes
values.UI look (follows the style sample): Rounded panels, violet accent, generous spacing
values.AI disclosure stance for stores (follows: Disclose AI-generated content wherever a store asks
